title: Princess Monterey Whale Watching
specs: We do not take children under 3 years of age.
Can I bring alcohol on the cruise?
No outside alcohol is allowed on the boat.
All kids age 3 - 6 years of age must wear a life vest for the duration of the cruise (children under 3 are not allowed on the cruise).
Children under 3 and pregnant women are not allowed on the trip.
You are always welcome to bring any food or drinks (no outside alcohol) of your own that you would like to enjoy along the way!

services.name: Whale Watching Cruise
services.desc: Discover the unforgettable adventure of whale watching on the two largest and finest vessels in the fleet. About Your trip will take place on either 110 ft. The Princess Monterey, or The Atlantis Monterey. You’ll enjoy a heated cabin, snack bar with both hot and cold beverages and snacks and spacious seating around the boat. The Atlantis Monterey and Princess Monterey boats have limited VIP upper deck seating available for an additional charge at the time of purchase. blurb: Princess Monterey Whale Watching has the two largest and finest whale watching vessels on Monterey Bay: the 110ft. Princess Monterey and the 100 ft. Atlantis Monterey. Both vessels are made for your comfort and have indoor heated cabins with large windows for viewing. They also feature large clean restrooms, a snack-bar, plenty of indoor and outdoor seating, and limited Upper Deck seating for an additional upgrade
